title: Acacia
body:
Description

The Acacia can be found on the grassy side of Ferwater Island near the bridge, and is uncommonly found in the desert. It has more branches than most other trees. It's also one of the few smaller trees on Finlay, other than Deadwood.

Once cut down, you can sell the log for $1 per stud. If you use the saw or a sander, you will create the sanded version of the wood which sells for $18 per stud. You can also use a planker to get the Planked version, which sells for $22.5 per stud.

Like any other material in the game, you can use logs, sanded, and planked Acacia to complete schematics.
